question: Should maintainers land this PR as the combined signed marketplace feed verifier/config/refresh/schema/CLI trust stack, or require the prerequisite trust PRs to land first and keep this PR to CLI visibility?
rationale: The branch spans verifier primitives, operator config, fail-closed loader behavior, SQLite snapshot state, and CLI diagnostics under a protected maintainer label, so automation should not choose the permanent trust and upgrade boundary.

options.title: Land prerequisites first
options.body: Land or close the verifier, config, and refresh-state trust PRs first, then rebase this PR to the remaining CLI visibility delta.

options.title: Adopt the combined stack
options.body: Resolve conflicts and review this PR as the single landing vehicle for the signed-feed trust stack.

options.title: Rescope the trust direction
options.body: Pause or narrow the branch if maintainers do not want signed marketplace feed config and fail-closed behavior in core now.

recommendation.title: Land prerequisites first
recommendation.body: Land or close the verifier, config, and refresh-state trust PRs first, then rebase this PR to the remaining CLI visibility delta.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the live assignee and has recent repair/review history on the trust-stack branch.
